The attached memo lists $103,427.16 as the allocation; it is not simply $850 x 77 pupils, since the memo says Alternative Education schools are funded on prior-year attendance.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: Roofing Constructors, Inc., doing business as Western Roofing Service, was the lowest responsible bidder for removing, disposing of and replacing the roof at 900 High Street.
